title: 🚨 MOST CHRISTIANS DON'T HAVE A MONEY PROBLEM.
paragraphs: 🚨 MOST CHRISTIANS DON'T HAVE A MONEY PROBLEM.
They have a stewardship problem.
Read that again.
The reason many believers stay stuck financially isn't because God forgot them.
It's because they never learned how to manage what He's already placed in their hands.
Some pray for increase...
But neglect stewardship.
Some ask God for abundance...
While wasting opportunity.
Some want financial freedom...
But never develop biblical wisdom.
THE CHRISTIAN INVESTOR
This isn't a "get rich quick" book.
This is a biblical guide to wealth, stewardship, investing, generosity, and Kingdom purpose.
Because money is a terrible master...
But a powerful servant when surrendered to God.
✅ What the Bible really teaches about investing and wealth
✅ How to grow financially without making money your idol
✅ Why fear keeps many Christians from multiplying what God entrusted to them
✅ The stewardship principles hidden inside the Parable of the Talents
✅ How to build wealth with wisdom, integrity, and Kingdom purpose
✅ How to leave a spiritual and financial legacy that honors Christ
✅ Practical biblical principles for managing money God's way
⚔️ HERE'S THE HARD TRUTH
Most people want God to multiply what they refuse to steward.
Most people pray for increase.
Few prepare for responsibility.
Most people chase money.
Few pursue wisdom.
Most people want blessing.
Few want stewardship.
The question is:
Which one are you?
🔥 THIS IS BIGGER THAN A BOOK

• Biblical truth
• Spiritual growth
• Faithful stewardship
• Kingdom impact
• Discipleship
• Sharing the Gospel worldwide

• Devotional resources
• And more
Not because we're trying to keep people out.
Because we're building a committed community of believers who are serious about growth, discipleship, and advancing God's Kingdom.
If you're ready to become a faithful steward...
If you're ready to stop making excuses...
If you're ready to honor God with every area of your life—including your finances...
If you're committed to biblical stewardship.
